submit_training_job: submit a SLURM job for fine-tuning a classification model on HuggingFace fine-pdfs dataset
generate_slurm_script: generate a SLURM script for training a model with configurable GPUs, partition, and time limit
run_training_cli: run the submit_training CLI to launch model training with custom dataset, learning rate, and sample count
sanitize_model_name: sanitize a HuggingFace model name for use in filesystem paths and job names
configure_training_args: configure training arguments including target column, max steps, subset, and prefix run name
